title: ACT-2: retain real SQLite learning negative results and all destination bytes
body:
Execute a bounded controlled SQLite study with actual tool transactions, independent readback, real linear-head and GRU optimization: 80 training trajectories, 80 confirmation instances, 8 model initialization seeds, 16 fits with 220 Adam steps each and 3,200 confirmation episodes per execution. These are five labelled arms; B0 and B2 share one policy and are explicitly redundant, and all tasks remain one normalized SQLite family.

The head matches the reference completion count, 512/640, with extra training/inference cost. GRU reaches 464/640, with additional UNKNOWN outcomes; its lower call count comes with lower quality. Neither necessary promotion predicate passes, so the fixed skill library is retained. No claim of full paid-cost optimality, product FinalUse integration, new independent field confirmation or general learned-hierarchy impossibility is made.

Retain both executions, the original pilot source, the exact run2 source postimages, all model weights/loss records/trajectories and a separate agent's 220-check review. The full original archive of all 3,280 physical SQLite databases is preserved losslessly as .zip.xz, below the unchanged 512,000-byte blob gate. A portable packaging helper restores exact original bytes and reruns the audit; its local execution also passed. Run2 repeats the exposed task set with instrumentation and is not a new independent confirmation set. Adam moments and full operational recovery/engineering costs are not retained/qualified.

Published research commit dc6c2ed2bf48e952f7e820d7ce8a9b8c72911539 binds exact local file-hash evidence; it is not represented as an already tested whole Git source. The hosted CPU replay and official formatter records are pending and will be reported separately. Depends on #5619; no deployment, main merge or full ACT-2 promotion.
